status: Ready for section audio collection; no audio or final video exists in this plan

target_final_duration_seconds.timing_basis: Measure supplied audio and actual screen interaction; do not treat estimated script timings as final

sections.topic: Request sheet and private direct read
Actual BA decision and frozen handoff
Actual engineering review and approved package

audio_collection.first_pass: Review 01_intro before the presenter records every section
audio_collection.retake_method: Leave about two seconds, then repeat the full sentence; or supply a new take for that section

editing_sequence: Inventory supplied recordings and identify the selected take for each section
Measure actual durations and assess voice level, noise and speech clarity
Review the first clip and provide short actionable feedback before remaining recording
Trim unintended silence and false starts while preserving natural pauses and meaning
Use light audio correction and consistent level where needed; avoid aggressive speed changes
Capture or select actual functional app interactions with source and generation mode visible
Capture the presenter making the actual BA and DE decisions after inspecting current results
Fit screen holds, pointer movements and section transitions to the reviewed narration
Align captions to the supplied speech and manually check technical terms and numbers
Render a captioned MP4, export the reviewed SRT, check playback and duration, then rebuild the submission ZIP

caption_plan.segmentation: Short spoken phrases and sentence boundaries; avoid splitting names, numbers or tightly linked phrases
caption_plan.timing_source: Actual supplied speech, reviewed against playback
caption_plan.readability: High contrast captions with a consistent lower-screen position that does not hide the active control or validation result

screen_capture_constraints.allowed_content: Synthetic DADS5250 sheet, dedicated local app, reviewed diagrams, report and project README
hide: Account dashboards not needed for the demo
screen_capture_constraints.removed_api_waits: Label any editing of waiting time clearly and retain actual start and completion states
screen_capture_constraints.unexpected_results: Match narration and captions to the actual observed result; revise or rerecord affected lines if necessary
